style_review: User liked all three illustrated candidates; latest instruction prioritizes pet quality and defers human portrait work.
parts_atlas_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent production cutout atlas for a Rive 2D puppy rig.
Input image: reference character sheet. Use ONLY puppy A on the LEFT as identity, design, color and painterly style reference. Ignore cat B and rabbit C.
Create a technically organized 3 by 3 equal-cell atlas, square image, transparent background, NO text, NO grid lines, NO shadows/backgrounds. Exactly nine isolated cutout parts, one per cell, each entirely contained inside its own cell with a generous transparent margin. Keep every cell center at the regular one-sixth/one-half/five-sixths positions of the square. These parts will be layered and animated in software. Maintain the same honey-and-white puppy A, soft detailed hand-painted fur edges, beautiful brown eyes, asymmetrical face marking, cream blaze, moss green cloth vest with actual seams, collar and buttons. Keep the illustration quality of the reference; do not simplify into plastic geometry.
Top row, 3 identically registered heads: 1) head eyes OPEN sweet calm expression; 2) SAME EXACT head, eyes gently CLOSED mid-blink; 3) SAME EXACT head, eyes open, mouth slightly open happy chewing. Each HEAD ONLY excludes both drooping ears (ears supplied separately), all neck clothing, torso and paws. Preserve fur cheek tufts, forehead, chin and nose. Head occupies around 80% of its cell width and 70% cell height, centered precisely. No head tilt and almost straight frontal view in all 3 cells. Keep silhouettes, features, scale and registration identical across head expressions.
Middle row: cell 4) seated puppy TORSO with moss-green vest, fluffy neck/chest, belly, haunches and TWO hind feet fully visible, but NO head, NO ears, NO tail, NO FRONT ARMS/PAWS. Cleanly complete the cloth and fur underneath where front arms would overlap; no holes. Torso occupies around 70% cell width and 85% cell height, centered.
cell 5) ONLY the puppy's left FRONT ARM AND PAW, an articulated-looking natural fluffy golden shoulder/upper arm into a white mitten paw; relaxed almost vertical pointing downward. No foot pad facing viewer. Paint the complete shoulder that can hide under fur. The part occupies around 28% cell width and 58% cell height, centered.
cell 6) ONLY the right FRONT ARM AND PAW, same type but correct asymmetrical matching color, relaxed vertical, complete shoulder, around 28% cell width and 58% height, centered.
Bottom row: cell 7) ONLY the puppy's long caramel-brown LEFT DROOPING EAR, whole ear and rounded root, detailed fur, vertically hanging, 33% cell width and 60% height, centered.
cell 8) ONLY the puppy's creamy golden RIGHT DROOPING EAR, slight fold and natural asymmetry, whole ear/root, vertically hanging, 33% cell width and 60% height, centered.
cell 9) ONLY the puppy's fluffy curved golden-and-cream TAIL, full tail with complete root, curling gently upward and left, 60% cell width and 55% height, centered.
Constraints: all nine parts are independent, clean real alpha transparency, no disconnected scraps or stray limbs, no assembled full puppy, no biscuits/human hands, no text/labels/checkerboard painted into the image. Do not add graphic borders, lines or registration marks. This is a layer atlas, NOT a pose sprite sheet: torso never contains head or front paws, heads never contain ears. Use ONE consistent original puppy design with brush-painted dimensional shading, no shiny rendering.
paw_replacement_atlas_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE transparent 2 by 2 atlas of FOUR hand-painted paired-forearm replacement drawings for a cutout game puppet.
Reference 1: original character sheet. Match ONLY puppy A, LEFT: honey/white fur, moss green vest, sweet seated proportions.
Reference 2: current cutout atlas: match the existing puppy forearms/paws' exact fur coloring and painting quality.
Produce FOUR isolated drawings of ONLY BOTH FRONT ARMS/PAWS of the SAME puppy. No heads, bodies, clothes, hind feet, tails, food, props, humans, grid lines, labels or shadows. Real alpha transparency. Each equal cell has generous transparent margins. Seamless soft fur edges, no straight cut lines, no geometric ribbon-like stretched fur. The arms should read anatomically as rounded shoulders, elbows, wrists and mitten paws, like professionally drawn 2D animation replacements.
All four cells must use THE SAME registration: two shoulder roots at 25% and 75% of the cell width, at 25% of its height. Root spacing identical in every pose. Rounded fluffy shoulder caps fully painted, with overlapping fur to hide the join. Each arm starts honey-gold, blending to an ivory white forepaw. The two arms in each cell remain clearly distinguishable. Camera is directly frontal, seated puppy as in reference. Keep anatomically plausible volumes and avoid overlong stretched arms.
Top LEFT (rest): relaxed front arms hanging down, paws near 35% and 65% width, 78% height; softly curved, natural and unequal.
Top RIGHT (receive): upper arms descend a little outwards, elbows round, white paws meet gently at center around 64% height as if cupping a biscuit, leaving a small central gap.
Bottom LEFT (lift to mouth): shoulder roots stay in EXACT SAME places as other cells. Elbows bend downwards and outward then white forepaws curl upward/inward, meeting delicately at 46% and 54% width, 22% height as if holding a small biscuit at a mouth just above the shoulders. Both wrists and elbows are rounded, believable, not crossed angular spikes. No fist covering an entire imaginary face. Natural holding pose, paws face each other. The complete arms can look like a shallow rounded W, not straight sticks.
Bottom RIGHT (satisfied): same shoulder roots, relaxed rounded elbows, forepaws resting together near the belly around 52% height, conveying a gentle comfortable belly pat.
Style: preserve the original high quality detailed yet soft hand-painted puppy fur, dimensional brush shading and natural contour tufts. These are ready-to-compose drawn pose replacements, never flattened or twisted textures. Keep actual limbs rounded and cute at small mobile-game size. Background completely transparent, NO visible backdrop checkerboard, NO text.
implementation: Native script-free Rive; atlas UV cutouts, layered head/ears/tail/body, expression and paw replacement drawings, authored timelines and state transitions. No raster image processing or generated human face.
limitations: Only puppy A is animated in this iteration.
Vest is painted into torso; wardrobe variants are future content, not implemented here.
Art and animation have not yet received user acceptance.
